query: Please implement a planning department order management system for managing order information. The system should have functionalities for pre-sales management, after-sales management, after-sales statistics, and order information statistics. Users should be able to log in, browse order information, add orders, update order status, maintain order information, and query order statistics. Initialize the background color with linen and component color with saddle brown.
